summary: Software Engineer with 3 years on a customer-facing authentication platform at enterprise scale. I work at the protocol level across OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT/JWKS, SSO and federation, and on the security layer beneath — PKI, X.509 lifecycle, mTLS and TLS termination. Outside work I build applied AI/ML systems: agentic RAG, real-time computer vision and quantitative platforms.

experience.title: Software Engineer, Identity & Platform Engineering
description: Zero sign-in downtime across 15+ app migrations from PCF to OpenShift. Part of the team that rebuilt auth integration, secure routing and IP allow-lists ahead of each cutover.
Certificate expiry no longer an outage risk. Worked on end-to-end mTLS with automated X.509 issuance and rotation, and TLS termination at the CDN edge.
Edge security moved with no downtime. Worked on the move from a legacy WAF to AWS CloudFront and WAFv2 across 10+ apps, with a phased DNS cutover.
Single sign-on and single logout across enterprise apps. Configured OIDC and OAuth clients in PingFederate and SecureAuth, including federation with Salesforce and Entra ID.
Java and Spring Boot services for registration, sign-in, token exchange, MFA and RBAC, plus upgrades, vulnerability fixes and CI/CD automation.
experience.intro: I work on the platform behind Telstra's customer sign-in: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows, sessions and MFA, and the certificates and edge security underneath.
